facts.text: The hotel is set in the northwestern corner of the Maasai Mara, at the foot of the Aitong Hills in the Olchoro Oirowua Conservancy.
facts.excerpt: Set in the northwestern corner of the Maasai Mara, at the foot of the Aitong Hills in the Olchoro Oirowua Conservancy

facts.text: The tented rooms are decorated in a fusion of traditional Maasai and heritage safari styles.
facts.excerpt: each beautifully adorned in an elegant fusion of traditional Maasai and heritage safari styles

facts.text: Riverfront tents have four-poster beds and en suite facilities.
facts.excerpt: Luxuriously furnished tents with four-poster beds and en suite facilities.

facts.text: Riverfront tents have private decks overlooking the river, with a view of the crocodiles and hippos below.
facts.excerpt: They have spacious private decks overlooking the river giving a vantage view of the crocodiles and hippos below.

facts.text: Deluxe riverfront tents have decks with sunbeds and an outdoor shower.
facts.excerpt: They have spacious private decks with sunbeds overlooking the river giving a vantage view of the crocodiles and hippos below, our deluxe tents also possess an outdoor shower.

facts.text: In-room dining is available, with views of the Mara River.
facts.excerpt: savor in-room dining with breathtaking views of the Mara River

facts.text: The hotel offers sunrise and night game drives and a bush breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Experience the wilderness with our beautiful sunrise and thrilling night game drives and indulge in a bush breakfast in the heart of Kenya.

facts.text: Guests can join a beekeeping adventure and watch hippos from the hotel's deck.
facts.excerpt: join our beekeeping adventure, witness hippos from our deck

facts.text: The hotel offers holistic spa treatments.
facts.excerpt: Relax and rejuvenate with holistic treatments designed to refresh your mind, body, and spirit

facts.text: Meals at the boma, which is designed to resemble a Masai manyatta (village), are served both indoors and out.
facts.excerpt: Meals at the boma, designed to resemble a Masai manyatta, or village, are served both indoors and out.

facts.text: Accommodations have Masai colors on the bedspreads and beaded curtains in the bathroom area.
facts.excerpt: Accommodations have Masai colors on the bedspreads and beaded curtains from South Africa in the bathroom area.

facts.text: Guests spot gazelles and lions along the banks of the Mara River.
facts.excerpt: Guests spot gazelles and lions along the banks of the Mara River

contradictions.note: p1 says 38 tented rooms, p3 says a 50-tent resort
